summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026 regarding the issuance of a convertible promissory note and warrant to an institutional investor. On May 10, 2026, the company issued a $1.75M convertible note for $1.575M (90% of principal) under a pre-existing Securities Purchase Agreement with up to $100M aggregate capacity. The note matures in 28 months, accrues 4% interest (14% upon default), and is convertible into ordinary shares at the lower of ~$1.73 or 88% of the 20-day VWAP (floor $0.346). The company also issued a warrant to purchase up to 1,119,098 shares at $1.56376 per share, exercisable for 5.5 years. Proceeds are for working capital. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
